question: The Niagara Falls drains the water from Lake Erie into __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lake Ontario.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Niagara River is a connecting channel between two Great Lakes, Erie and Ontario.
 
• It drains the water from Lake Erie into Lake Ontario.
 
• Water from Lake Erie flows uncontrolled* through the Niagara River and Welland Canal into Lake Ontario.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Niagara Falls is a group of three waterfalls** at the southern end of Niagara Gorge.
 
• The three waterfalls are **Horseshoe falls, American falls and Bridal Veil Falls.**
 
• The **largest of the three is Horseshoe Falls**, which straddles the international border of the two countries.
 
• It is also known as the** Canadian Falls.**
 
• **The smaller American Falls and Bridal Veil Falls** lie within the United States.
 
• Bridal Veil Falls is separated from Horseshoe Falls by Goat Island and from American Falls by Luna Island, with both islands situated in New York.
